key.name: session
key.description: Passed as herdr --session NAME, and used to find the terminal window running that session. Empty means the default session.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Each poll runs herdr agent list once.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show agent status in the top bar

key.name: overlay-badge
key.summary: When to show the floating badge
key.description: The badge floats above all windows, including fullscreen ones, and takes clicks only inside itself. "attention" shows it only while an agent is blocked or done; the hotkey still opens the menu.

key.name: badge-position
key.description: Fractions (0 to 1) of the free space in the monitor's work area, left and top. Set by dragging the badge; negative means the default top-right corner.

key.name: badge-monitor
key.description: Connector name (e.g. DP-1) of the monitor the badge was dragged to. Empty, or a monitor that is not connected, means the primary monitor.

key.name: toast
key.summary: Show a toast when an agent is done or needs you
key.description: A small message next to the badge, also over fullscreen windows (GNOME's own banners are held back there).

key.name: toast-done
key.summary: Toast when an agent is done

key.name: toast-blocked
key.summary: Toast when an agent needs you (blocked)

key.name: badge-dot
key.summary: Show the attention dot on the badge
key.description: Red when an agent is blocked, green when one is done.

key.name: badge-ring
key.description: A 2 px ring around the badge showing the latest status change, one at a time: a spinning blue arc when an agent starts working, a green ring filling up when one is done, a pulsing red ring when one is blocked. When nothing is queued it spins while any agent is working.
